author: spidey simp
description: A custom court and judicial administration system developed for the Spidey Republic server, including case filing, dockets, court proceedings, judicial administration, reporters, and related court functions.
install_msg: SpideyCourts is designed specifically for the Spidey Republic server and is not intended for general installation.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs and court-related data, including parties, attorneys, filings, case records, and other judicial-system information.
